name: 纤细极简
description: 源自 rico-md 的「纤细极简」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 24px 40px 24px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; color: {{codeText}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 39px; font-weight: 200; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.15; margin: 48px 0 24px; letter-spacing: -0.025em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 28px; font-weight: 300; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.2; margin: 40px 0 20px; letter-spacing: -0.018em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.25; margin: 32px 0 24px; letter-spacing: -0.008em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

listItem.html: • {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; border: none; font-weight: 500; color: {{heading}}">{{content}}</th>

tableCell.html: {{content}}

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 56px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: #d2d2d7; max-width: 48px">
